messages.subject: CXXR on Github
messages.body_plain:
I've setup a github organization and repositories for CXXR.

https://github.com/cxxr-devel

There are currently two repos there:
  - cxxr-svn-mirror which is a read-only mirror of the svn repository.
  - cxxr

The cxxr repository is connected both to cxxr-svn-mirror and wch/r-source (which mirrors CR svn).  This is particularly useful, because it allows changes from CR to be pulled in with full history via the usual git merge mechanisms, which should make it a lot easier to do.

If you have a github account, I can add you to the org.

messages.subject: R JIT code
messages.body_plain:
I've put the jit code I have so far up on github (kmillar/cxxr <https://github.com/kmillar/cxxr>, branch cxxr-jit).

So far, it doesn't do much -- it merely compiles the single expression that is the body of an R function into native code that calls the interpreter.  It translates the AST directly into LLVM IR, without any intermediate representation in between.

I'll be working on implementing symbol lookup (using FrameDescriptors like FastR) and control flow next.

Karl
